outcome: duration of first phase of labor
duration of second phase of labor
duration of third phase of labor
cohort: Three hundred ninety pregnant women who were giving birth via vaginal delivery participated in the study.
finding: Nipple and uterine stimulation significantly shortened the average durations of the first and second phases of labor and reduced the application of labor induction compared to the control group.
mod_finding: No women in the nipple or uterine stimulation groups had a cesarean section, compared to 8.5% in the control group.
